༄༅/ /springs yig gi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// springs yig gi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs//

dpal khrag 'thung chen po khro rgyal 'bar ba'i bden pas/ snang srid kyi 'byung rigs spyi la zlo ba/ deng 'dir mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa 'di dag /kho bos dkon mchog la skyabs su gsol yod pas/ gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor ring du spongs bar gyis/ gal te bka' 'das log par gyur tshe/ dpal ye shes kyi khro bo che mchog 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis brlag par gyur ta re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' bden pas// snang zhing srid pa'i 'byung po mchis so cog /gson cig deng 'dir bsrung bar bya ba yi// mi nor phyugs la gnod cing nyer 'tshe'i rigs// sbyor ngan log pa'i 'gal rkyen spongs bar gyis// ci ste mi nyan 'tshe bar byed gyur na// ye shes khro chen 'bar ba'i nus rtsal gyi// zhugs char drag pos lus srog brlag ta re// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ khrag 'thung padma drag po'i bka' bden pas// gang zhig rnal 'byor byang chub spyod pa la// 'tshe ba'i log 'dren gzugs can gzugs med kyis// tho 'tsham glags lta'i bar chad ma byed cig /gal te bka' 'das dam las 'gal gyur na// khro rgyal stobs 'dus 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis// me yi tsha tsha skar mda' ltar 'phros nas// thal bar brlag par 'gyur bar gdon mi za// rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/// / ༈ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i mthu las// deng 'dir bsrung bya dam ldan 'di la// gnod pa'i sems 'chang 'dre gdon 'byung po// rang rig phung khams dpe zlar longs la// gdod nas 'gro kun ma bur 'brel ba// ma rig 'khrul 'byams dbang gis bsgribs kyang*// deng bzung byams pa'i sems kyi ngang nas// glags lta'i bsam sbyor myur bar spongs shig /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ dpal khrag 'thung gi rgyal po khro bo chen po'i bden pas/ snang zhing srid pa'i 'byung po yid kyi lus can yongs la bzlo ba/ deng zhing yul ljongs 'di rnams dkon mchog la skyabs su gsol yod pas/

gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam pa mtha' dag ring du spongs la zhi dang byams pa'i sems kyis skyongs bar gyis/ bsgo ba las 'das na rgyu 'bras blang dor gyi bden pas brlag par 'gyur ta re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ dpal ye shes kyi khro chen hya gṛ wa'i lung*/ snang srid kyi lha klu gzhi bdag 'byung po mthu bo che rnams dang*/ bye brag srog bcad dbugs len gyi gshed mar rlom pa'i 'dre srin phra'u rnams la mchid smra ba/ deng mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa dkon mchog la skyabs su gsol yod pas/ gnod cing mi dge'i mtshan ltas kyi rigs ring du spang bar gyis la/ ma bu bzhin snying rje'i gnas yangs par spyod cig /gal te tho 'tsham glags ltar gyur na rdo rje'i me char gyis bsdig par 'gyur ro// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ dkon mchog bden pa'i mthu byin gyis// deng 'dir zhing sar gnod byed pa'i// 'byung tshogs glags ltar gyur pa rnams// zhi dang byams pa'i sems ldan byos// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ dpal padma thod phreng rtsal gyi byin rlabs 'dis// snang srid kyi 'byung rigs kun la mchid smra ba/ deng 'dir bsrung bya mi nor 'di dag kho bos dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol yod pas gnod sems mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i las yongs su spang bar gyis/ spyir gdod nas ma bur 'brel ba'i bsam pa dag kyang bzung la/ zhi zhing dge ba'i ngang nas byams pa'i sems dang ldan par spyod na 'phral yun du bde ba'i btsas su smin zhing*/ gal te bka' 'das nyams pa'i gnas gyur tshe/ che mchog drag po he ru ka'i gzi byin gyis brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ ye shes dbyings las khro bo'i skur// bzhengs pa'i dpal chen he ru ka /rdo rje gzhon nu'i bden pa yis// deng 'dir bsrung bya mi nor kun// mchog gsum mgon la skyabs song bas// nyer 'tshe phra rags ring spangs nas// zhi dang byams ba'i sems ldan ngang*// rang lus dpe ru mtshon gyis la/

gzhan la gnod sems spang bar byos// gal te bka' 'das 'tshe byed na// khro bo 'bar ba'i mthu stobs kyis// brlag par 'gyur gyi tha tshig nyon// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes dkon mchog lha btsan ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ rang byung ye shes khro bo'i rgyal// rdo rje gzhon nu'i bden pa'i mthus// snang dang mi snang 'byung tshogs nyon// deng 'dir bsrung byar 'os pa 'di// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs gsol bas// phyin chad glags lta'i bsam sbyor spongs// gal te bka' 'das dam 'gal na/ khro bo'i me char drag po yis// lus srog thal bar brlag nas kyang*// rgyu 'bras blang dor bslu med mthus// na raka duḥkha myong bar 'gyur// de bas rdo rje'i tha tshig nyon// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ chos dbyings rol pa'i klong nas/ rgya dar rgyas ngor spel/ ༈ chos dbyings ngang las khro bo'i sku// nag po chen po rdo rje ber// thugs rje'i mthu stobs bden pa'i mthus// deng 'dir bsrung bya mi nor kun// snang srid 'byung po'i glags lta'i sems// sbyor ba ngan pa spongs bar gyis// gal te dam 'gal 'tshe byed na// bka' yi chad pas bsdig par 'gyur// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bro zong sgrol ma tshe ring ngor spel/ ༈ padma khrag 'thung bden pa'i mthus// gang zhig bsrung bya mi nor bcas// snang srid 'byung pos gnod 'tshe spongs// bka' 'das gyur tshe chad pas bsdigs// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi mes dpal che mchog gu ru drag po'i bden pas/ deng 'dir bsrung bya 'khor dang bcas pa dkon mchog la skyabs gsol bas/ snang zhing srid pa'i 'byung bo yid kyi lus can mtha' dag gis gnod sems sbyor ngan gyi 'tshe ba spongs bar gyis/ gal te bka' 'das log par gyur tshe khro bo'i me char drag pos lus srog thal bar brlag nas rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i bden pas na raka duḥkha myong bar gyur ta re/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ chos dbyings stong chen klong nas bris/// / ༈ dpal rdo rje gro lod kyi bden pas/ deng 'dir bsrung bya mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol bas/ phyin chad 'tshe bar ma ldang zhig /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ dkon mchog kun 'dus padma 'byung*// drag por bzhengs pa khro bo lod// gang gi ye shes nyi 'od kyis// bdud dgra log rtog mun tshogs bcom// bsrung bar bya ba'i dam ldan 'di// bar chad g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing*// gtan bde dam pa'i chos bsgrub par// 'byung tshogs glags ltar ma byed cig hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ dpal chen khro rgyal he ru ka /bgegs mthar byed kyi bden pa'i mthus// 'byung po'i rigs rnams 'dir nyon cig /deng 'dir bsrung bya mi nor bcas// mchog gsum dam par skyabs gsol bas// phyin chad 'tshe bar ma byed cig /gal te bka' 'das dam 'gal na// drag po'i me yis brlag ta re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ che mchog rdo rje drag rtsal gyi// bka' yi bden pa zab mo yis// deng 'dir bsrung bya 'di kun la// gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po yis// nyes pa'i bsam pa rab spongs shig /gang zhig bsgo ba las 'das na// ye shes khro bo chen po yi// rdo rje me char 'bar bas ni// brlag gyur sdug bsngal myong ta re/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐// rang rig ka dag spros med kyi klong nas springs pa'o// ༈ khro rgyal gdug pa 'dul ba'i gtso// he ru ka yi bden pa'i mthus// snang zhing srid pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus lus med gyur rnams la// tha tshig gnyen po 'di bsgrag go// spyir gyi sems can thams cad kun// gdod nas ma bur 'brel ba ltar// des na gnod sems glags lta'i rigs// phra ba'ang ring du spang bya ste// de lta'i rgyu dang 'bras bu yis// mthar thug bde dga'i dpal thob 'gyur// bka' las log par 'tshe byed na// khro bo rol pa'i gzi byin gyis// lus srog thal ba'i rdul phran ltar// brlag par 'gyur gyi ngan song gi

/g.yang sa chen por ltung nyen no// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ mtha' klas stong chen gyi dbyings nas springs ba'o// ༈ snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams// nyon cig padma drag rtsal bka' bden pas// yul ris rgyal khams grong khyer 'di nyid du// 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor gdug pa'i las gang dag /rang lus dpe mtshon gyis la ring spongs shig /des na 'bras bu ma nor rgyud smin nas// nam zhig bde nas bde bar bsgrod gyur cig /gal te dam 'gal tho 'tsham glags lta na// ye shes rdo rje gdengs pa'i mthu stobs kyis// lus sreg thal bar brlag cing mnar med pa'i// duḥkha chen po myang ba'i gzhir 'gyur gyi// bka' dang dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// /ye gdod stong chen gyi dbyings nas springs ba'o// ༈ dkon mchog bden pa'i mthu byin gyis// deng 'dir zhing sar gnod byed pa'i// 'byung tshogs glags ltar gyur pa rnams// zhi dang byams pa'i sems ldan byos/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ rgyal kun gsang gsum gcig dril ba// padma thod phreng mngon spyod tshul// skur bzhengs gu ru drag po yi// bka' yi bden pa nyi 'bum gyi// thugs rje'i 'od zer snang ba des// log rtog ma rig drwa ba yis// kun tu dkrigs pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs// yid kyi lus can gang su dag /deng 'dir skye 'gror gnod byed pa'i// btsa' sad ser sogs lo dgra rnams// rang lus dper mtshon gyis la spongs// bka' dang dam la nyams gyur na// khro chen 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis// lus srog rtsad nas gzhil bar byed// rnam smin 'bras bu duḥkha myong*// yid kyi padmor gnas par gyis// hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/// / ༈ kyai/ snang srid gnyis bsdus 'byung po'i tshogs// padma thod 'phreng he ru ka'i// rdo rje tha tshig bka' la nyon// deng 'dir yi ge 'chang ba po// mi nor 'khor bcas dkon mchog la// skyabs su gsol bas nyer 'tshe'i gegs// sbyor ba rtsub po ring spongs shig

/gal te mi nyan bka' 'das na// chos can chos nyid bden pa yis// thal bar brlag par gdon mi za/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ snang srid 'khor 'das spyi dpal che// gu ru drag po me phreng gi /bka' la 'byung tshogs kun nyon cig /yi ge 'chang ba mi nor rnams// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs gsol bas// deng bzung khyod rnams glags lta ba'i// nyer 'tshe 'gal rkyen spongs bar gyis// gal te mi nyan bka' 'das na// chos dbyings don dam bden pa dang*// chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med pas// thal bar brlag par gdon mi za/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// /chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong nas spel/ ༈ rang byung dbyings las khro bo'i sku// dpal chen rngam pa'i gzi brjid can// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje mchog /gang gi mthu stobs 'chang de yis// bsrung bar bya ba'i mi nor dang*// zhing khams dngos snang gdod bcas kun// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs gsol bas// gang dag mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i gegs// nyes par gyur rnams ring spongs la// zhi dang byams pa'i ngang gnas gyis// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ skye med ngang las 'gags med 'phrul// thugs rje'i gar ston rtsa gsum gyi// bden pas bsrung byar god 'dre dang*// dbul sri la sogs 'gong po rnams// glags lta'i 'tshe ba ring spongs shig /rang lus dper mtshon zhi ba dang*// byams pa'i ngang du gnas par gyis// bka' 'das chos can chos nyid kyi// las 'bras drag pos mnar ta re// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ hūm̐/ ye shes dbyings las mngon spyod kyi// khro bo rol ba'i sku 'bar ba// gtum chen rdo rje drag rtsal gyi// bden pas snang srid 'byung po kun// deng 'dir gnod 'tshe'i las spongs shig /gal te bsgo ba las 'das na// chos can chos nyid bden pa yis// brlag par 'gyur gyi gdon mi za// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ dpal he ru ka dbang drag khro bo rol pa'i bka' yi bden pas/

deng 'dir bsrung byar gyur pa'i skye 'gro 'di rnams/ dkon mchog gsum dngos o rgyan rig 'dzin padma kā rar skyabs su gsol bas/ gnod byed nyer 'tshe'i 'byung rigs khyed rnams kyis skyin thang 'bab pa sogs mdor na bsam sbyor sdang ba'i sems ring du spongs par gyis la/ byams pa'i ngang las snying rjes rgyud brlan pas ci bder skyongs bar gyis/ gal te bka' las 'das na las 'bras bslu med kyi blang dor dang*/ chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis mnar med dmyal bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes pa'i yi ge kun khyab bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas spel/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ khams gsum dbang bsgyur rgyal ba'i rgyal// gu ru padma thod phreng gi /byin rlabs stobs 'chang bden pa'i gzis// snang srid sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs// bka' dang dam gnas ma lus pa// khyed rnams chos nyid bden pa yi// don la bsam pas deng 'di ru// bsrung byar 'os pa'i dam ldan rnams// sgo gsum 'tshe ba ring spangs la// lhar bcas bstod 'os sangs rgyas bstan// rgyal ba'i sdong grogs ma g.yel sgrubs// de mthus byang chub 'bras smin pa'i// gtan bde'i go 'phang myur thob 'gyur// des na rnam kun chos spyod cig /se tsha bla grwa'i ngor spel ba dge// / ༈ hrīḥ rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs padma badzra rtsal// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa// dmar nag me phreng drag po'i bka' bden pas// deng 'dir yul ris sa phyogs 'di dag rnams// dkon mchog dam par skyabs tshol deng phyin chad// sde brgyad 'byung po phra rags khyed rnams kyis// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i sbyor ba ring spongs shig /gal te bka' las 'das na lus ngag yid// ye shes rdo rje 'bar bas brlag ta re// badzra sa ma ya rakṣa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/// / ༈ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bo padma 'byung*// dbang drag rol pa dpal chen he ru ka'i// rigs sngags 'chang ba padma dbang chen rtsal// zhes su grags des bden pa'i tshig 'di kwa// snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre 'byung po'i rigs// gnyug mar gnas dang glo bur lhags pa yi// yid kyi gzugs can khyod rnams 'dir gson cig

/bsrung bya dam ldan slob ma 'di rnams dang*// rkang bzhi rta phyugs gnag lug bcas pa rnams// bla med dkon mchog gsum la skyabs gsol zhing*// mi phyed ye shes srung ba'i 'khor lor bcug /stong dang snying rje zung 'brel go cha bsgos// rdo rje'i rig pa mchog gi lha dang sngags// bde chen rdo rje'i ngo bor byin brlabs pas// khyod rnams brnag pa'i bsam sbyor 'tshe ba'i rigs// spongs la phyin chad khyim sgo lam srang 'dir// ma 'grim gnas gzhan spos la zhi ba dang*// byams pa'i ngang nas bka' las ma 'da' zhing*// gal te bsgo ba'i smreng las 'das gyur na// chos can chos nyid bden pa zab mo dang*// khyad par khro chen me yi phreng ba yi// bka' chad drag po'i rdo rje'i zhugs char dang*// khyung sdig pho nyas lus srog rdul du brlag /rnam smin na raka duḥkha myong ta re// de bas don dam dbyings las ma 'da' zhig /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ badzra kro dha rakṣa rakṣa/// / ༈ rgyal kun ngo bo o rgyan padma 'byung*// drag por bzhengs pa rdo rje me phreng can// deng 'dir chos min dam sri'i 'tshe ba las// srungs shig skyobs shig badzra rakṣa hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang ras sprul mchog gi bzhed ltar yul sde kun la sman phyir bris/// / ༈ oṃ/ rdo rje gro lod rtsal gyi bka'// āḥ rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i lung*// hūm̐/ snang zhing srid pa'i 'byung po nyon// hoḥ bsrung bya mi nor 'di rnams la/ phaṭa/ nyer 'tshe bar chad ma btang bar// zhi dang byams pa'i sems ldan ngang*// rang lus dper longs gzhan gnod spongs// badzra kro dha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/// / ༈ oṃ/ rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po'i bka'// āḥ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi lung*// hūm̐/ sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gson// hoḥ deng 'dir bsrung bya mi nor la// phaṭa/ nad yams bar chad ring spongs shing*// byams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyis// tsitta badzra sa ma ya rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/// /

༈ stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag sangs rgyas bden pa dang*// zhi ba chags bral chos mchog bla med bden// rig grol sar gnas dge 'dun tshogs rnams kyi// bka' yi bden pa zab mo'i mthu chen pos// 'byung po sde brgyad ma lus 'dir gson la// yul ris ljongs 'dir gnas pa'i skye dgu rnams// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol zin pas// phyin chad gnod cing 'tshe ba'i glags lta'i rigs// skyin thang 'bebs sogs cho 'phrul ring spongs shig /zhi dang byams pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis// gal te tho 'tsham 'gal ba'i las bgyis na// las 'bras blang dor duḥkha myong ta re// de bas tshul 'dir bag yod brtan par mdzod// chos sku'i rigs klong dag pa'i dbyings nas bris// zhes pa'ang lhang tho'i ri brag pa grong mi rnams kyi ched du spel ba dge// /
